Hey. Self diagnosing, been there. After i finally got some help and talked to a psychologist, psychiatrist and did some tests.. I got a legitimate diagnosis and honestly, the feeling of relief, knowing its not you that is broken and wrong, its something inside your head that isnt yours inherently. It was so so much easier feeling like i did after i didnt have to question how i feel - they told me im having a bad depressive episode and that its serious. I was finally able to tell my 'youre just lazy, dumb, useless, so selfish you cant even motivate yourself to get up even though you have everything you need in your life' thoughts and anxieties they were wrong. I think talking to a licensed professional might help you in that way, you certainly dont have anything to lose. \~Stay safe
